title: If … not and unless; if and whether
summary: Когда unless можно заменить на if ... not, а когда нельзя; чем различаются if и whether в косвенных вопросах и когда необходим только whether.
ru:
## unless = «если только не»
**Unless** значит **except if** («кроме случая, когда»). В большинстве предложений он взаимозаменяем с **if ... not**:
> I'll go for a run **unless** it rains. = I'll go for a run **if it doesn't rain**. — Пойду бегать, если не будет дождя.
> **Unless** you hurry, you'll miss the train. = **If you don't hurry**, you'll miss the train.
Сам **unless** уже содержит отрицание, поэтому второе отрицание не нужно: ~~Unless you don't hurry~~ → **Unless you hurry**.

## Когда unless нельзя
У unless есть ограничения, и именно здесь ошибаются продвинутые ученики.
- **Эмоциональная реакция на то, что чего-то не произойдёт.** Если чувство (радость, огорчение, удивление) вызвано именно тем, что действие **не** случится, нужен **if ... not**: *I'll be glad **if** she doesn't come.* — Я буду рад, если она не придёт. (~~unless she comes~~ так не говорят: unless значит «кроме случая, когда» и не называет причину чувства.)
- **Нереальные условия в прошлом.** В третьем условном обычно **if ... not**: *If you hadn't warned me, I'd have missed it.* (~~Unless you had warned me~~ звучит неестественно.)
- Вопросы: ~~Unless it rains, will you go?~~ → **If it doesn't rain**, will you go?

## Сокращённые конструкции с unless
После unless можно опустить подлежащее и be в формальных текстах и инструкциях:
> Don't call me **unless urgent**. — Не звони, если не срочно.
> **Unless otherwise stated**, all prices include tax. — Если не указано иное, цены включают налог.

## only if
**Only if** — «только если»: *You can enter **only if** you have a pass.* Когда **only if** в начале, нужна инверсия: ***Only if** you have a pass **can you** enter.*

## if и whether: косвенный вопрос
После **ask, wonder, know, see, not sure, doubt** и подобных для вопроса «да / нет» используем **if** или **whether**. **Whether** формальнее.
> I asked **if / whether** the report was ready. — Я спросил, готов ли отчёт.
> I'm not sure **whether / if** she's coming.

## Когда нужен только whether
- **перед инфинитивом**: We haven't decided **whether to** accept the offer. (~~if to accept~~)
- **после предлога**: It depends **on whether** the funding is approved. (~~on if~~)
- **подлежащее / дополнение при be**: **Whether** he agrees is irrelevant. The question is **whether** we can afford it.
- **сразу перед or not**: I'll let you know **whether or not** I get the job.
- **после discuss, consider**: *They discussed whether the law should change.*
Как условный союз **if** («если») — только if: *If it rains, we'll stay in.* Поэтому предложение *Let me know if you need a lift* можно понять двояко, но обычно ясно по контексту.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Unless you don't call me, I'll come.~~ → **Unless you call** me, I'll come.
- ~~I don't know if to apply.~~ → I don't know **whether to** apply.
- ~~It depends on if the board approves.~~ → on **whether**.
- ~~I'll be upset unless they come.~~ → I'll be upset **if they don't** come.
en:
## unless = 'except if'
**Unless** means **except if**. In most sentences it can replace **if ... not**:
> I'll go for a run **unless** it rains. = I'll go for a run **if it doesn't rain**.
> **Unless** you hurry, you'll miss the train. = **If you don't hurry**, you'll miss the train.
**Unless** already has a negative meaning, so we don't add another one: ~~Unless you don't hurry~~ → **Unless you hurry**.

## When unless is not possible
These limits are where advanced learners make mistakes.
- **Emotional reactions to something that does not happen.** When a feeling is caused by something not happening, use **if ... not**: *I'll be glad **if** she doesn't come.* (not ~~unless she comes~~: unless means 'except if', it does not give the cause of a feeling.)
- **Unreal past conditions.** In the third conditional use **if ... not**: *If you hadn't warned me, I'd have missed it.*
- **Questions**: ~~Unless it rains, will you go?~~ → **If it doesn't rain**, will you go?

## Shortened clauses with unless
In formal texts and instructions we can leave out the subject and be:
> Don't call me **unless urgent**.
> **Unless otherwise stated**, all prices include tax.

## only if
**Only if** = 'only in the case that': *You can enter **only if** you have a pass.* At the start of a sentence it needs inversion: ***Only if** you have a pass **can you** enter.*

## if and whether in indirect questions
After **ask, wonder, know, see, not sure, doubt** and similar words we can use **if** or **whether** for yes / no questions. **Whether** is more formal.
> I asked **if / whether** the report was ready.
> I'm not sure **whether / if** she's coming.

## When only whether is possible
- **before an infinitive**: We haven't decided **whether to** accept the offer. (~~if to accept~~)
- **after a preposition**: It depends **on whether** the funding is approved. (~~on if~~)
- **as a subject or after be**: **Whether** he agrees is irrelevant. The question is **whether** we can afford it.
- **directly before or not**: I'll let you know **whether or not** I get the job.
- **after discuss, consider**: *They discussed whether the law should change.*
As a conditional conjunction ('if it happens') only **if** works: *If it rains, we'll stay in.*

## Common mistakes
- ~~Unless you don't call me~~ → **Unless you call** me
- ~~I don't know if to apply.~~ → I don't know **whether to** apply.
- ~~It depends on if the board approves.~~ → on **whether**
- ~~I'll be upset unless they come.~~ → I'll be upset **if they don't** come.
structure:
## unless и if ... not
| Ситуация | unless | if ... not |
|---|---|---|
| обычное условие | Unless you hurry, you'll be late. | If you don't hurry, you'll be late. |
| эмоция в результате | неверно | I'll be sad if you don't come. |
| нереальное прошлое | неестественно | If you hadn't called, I'd have missed it. |
| вопрос | неверно | If it doesn't rain, will you go? |
| краткая форма | Unless urgent, don't call. | — |

## if и whether
| Позиция | if | whether |
|---|---|---|
| после ask / wonder / know | да | да (формальнее) |
| перед to + инфинитивом | нет | да |
| после предлога | нет | да |
| подлежащее / после be | нет | да |
| перед or not | нет | да |
| условие («если») | да | нет |

## Формулы
> **unless** + подлежащее + глагол (без отрицания)
> **whether** + to + V  ·  **whether** ... **or not**  ·  preposition + **whether** + clause
> **Only if** + вспомогательный глагол + подлежащее ... (инверсия в начале)

exercises.title: unless, if или whether?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте unless, if или whether (если допустимы оба — достаточно любого).
exercises.example: I'll take the job ___ the salary is too low. → **unless**

items.text: I'll take the job {{unless}} the salary is too low.
{{Unless}} you hurry, you'll miss the train.
We haven't decided {{whether}} to accept the offer.
I'll be disappointed {{if}} you don't come.
It depends on {{whether}} the funding is approved.
{{Whether}} or not it rains, the event will take place.
She asked {{if|whether}} I had finished the report.
You won't be admitted {{unless}} you have a ticket.
I doubt {{whether|if}} they will accept the proposal.
We'll go ahead with the trip {{whether or not|regardless of whether}} the weather improves.
Let me know {{if|whether}} you need a lift.
I'd be grateful {{if}} you could send the document today.
You can enter {{only if|if}} you have a pass.

items.q: Don't call the doctor ___ the pain gets worse.
